facts.text: I am looking to schedule a bike maintenance class.
I asked whether Cycle World offers bike maintenance classes.
I took my mountain bike out for a 25-mile ride.
I noticed my mountain bike was making strange noises today.
I plan to troubleshoot the rear derailleur issue myself first.
I want to check the derailleur hanger for misalignment.
I want to adjust the limit screws on the rear derailleur.
I want to inspect the cassette and identify worn-out teeth.
I want to clean the cassette effectively.
I am worried about damaging the cassette.
I think I will take my bike to a local bike shop for a professional assessment and cleaning.
I want to know how often to replace my cassette.
I want a general rule of thumb for cassette replacement.
I will take my bike to the local bike shop to have them inspect the cassette and rear derailleur.
I will ask the local bike shop to check the bike overall to make sure everything is in good condition.
I want to know whether the local bike shop will be able to fix the strange noise issue with the rear derailleur or whether I will need to replace it.
I will ask the local bike shop to give me an estimate of the cost of the repairs before they start working on the bike.

events.text: Noticed strange noises from the rear derailleur after a 25-mile mountain bike ride
Planned to troubleshoot the rear derailleur issue by checking derailleur hanger alignment and adjusting limit screws
Planned to inspect the cassette for worn teeth and clean the cassette
Planned to take the bike to a local bike shop for professional assessment and cleaning
Planned to have the local bike shop inspect the cassette and rear derailleur and check the bike overall
Planned to request a cost estimate before the local bike shop starts repairs
